# Retinue license reference

## Current source license

Copyright (c) 2026 JKL Thinking. The current source tree uses
**AGPL-3.0-only**, with a separate commercial licensing option.

- Personal use and internal company use are free, including commercial use.
- If you modify Retinue and provide it to outside users over a network, you
  must offer those users the modified version's Corresponding Source under AGPL.
- If you do not want to meet those requirements, you can buy a commercial license.
- **Versions 0.3.0a4 and earlier released under MIT remain MIT forever.**

Distribution and other uses must also meet the applicable AGPL requirements.
This applies to the development tree after that cutoff; old releases and tags
are unchanged. See [LICENSE](LICENSE), [NOTICE](NOTICE),
[commercial terms](COMMERCIAL.md), [contributor agreement](CLA.md) and
[trademarks](TRADEMARKS.md). Third-party dependencies retain their own terms;
see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Commercial licensing


Retinue's core is available under **AGPL-3.0-only**, with a separate commercial
license offered by JKL Thinking. Personal use, internal company use, and
commercial use that complies with AGPL are free. Charging money, being a
company, or hosting a service does not by itself require a paid license.
See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the complete terms.

### When to obtain a commercial license

Obtain one before a use for which you cannot or do not wish to meet AGPL's
applicable requirements, such as:

- Distributing a modified version or a derivative product while keeping the
  covered source closed.
- Modifying Retinue and offering it to external users over a network without
  offering those users the Corresponding Source required by AGPL section 13,
  including modifications and necessary build and installation materials.
- Embedding Retinue into a proprietary product that forms a covered combined work.
- Working under a company policy that prohibits AGPL software.

Calling an independent interface does not automatically create a derivative
work; the integration must be assessed on its facts. Hosting an unmodified
copy alone does not trigger section 13's modified-version requirement.
Distribution of software or clients still carries the applicable AGPL duties.

### What the commercial license includes

A signed contract specifies the covered versions, legal entities, term,
deployments and distribution scope. Within that scope, it permits use,
modification, integration or distribution of code that JKL Thinking has the
right to license commercially without that code's AGPL source-disclosure
requirements. Support, SLAs, hosting, enterprise features, upgrades and pricing
are included only when expressly agreed. Hosted offerings and enterprise
features may be supplied from private repositories; the open core grants no
automatic access to them.

Third-party license obligations remain separate. Trademark and logo rights
are not included automatically. This document describes options; it is not an
executed commercial contract. Without such a license, AGPL applies.

Contact: <商业授权联系方式：待女王提供>

**Versions 0.3.0a4 and earlier released under MIT remain MIT forever.**
This change is not retroactive.

## Trademarks


The names Retinue, RETINUE and 众卿, and the project logo, are marks reserved by
JKL Thinking. **AGPL-3.0-only for the code does not grant trademark rights in
these names or logos.**

You may refer to the project accurately (for example, “a fork of Retinue” or
“compatible with Retinue”), link to the official repository, and retain the
name and logo when running an unmodified official release. Required copyright,
origin and license notices must remain.

Forks, redistributions and third-party hosted services must not impersonate
Retinue or use its marks in domains, store listings, document titles or
marketing to imply official status, endorsement or affiliation. Use your own
product name and marks for a derivative version. An altered logo must not be
presented as the official mark either. Accurate, necessary attribution remains
permitted. A commercial code license does not automatically include trademarks.

This policy addresses marks and confusion; it adds no restriction to AGPL's
rights to use, modify and distribute the code.
Official project: https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue .
